'''Martin Akesson Akesson MWYHL''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Martin Akesson]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls90.htm Akesson MWYHL], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319194357/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls90.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
